description.text:
《職務說明》
1. 依專案需求調研演算法等技術於相關應用議題
2. 基於CAD設計工具與CAE模擬工具的應用開發
3. 協同開發、佈建與測試解決方案於應用運算場域
《Qualification》
1. 熟悉Python, Java, Matlab, C/C++等任一資料分析程式語言
2. 熟悉數值分析、最佳化演算法、機器/深度學習 等實務經驗
3. 熟悉Git版控工具，以及API、SDK、Qt開發經驗
4. 善於溝通協調與團隊合作精神並能獨立解決問題
--
《Responsibility》
1. Investigate algorithms and other technologies and related application issues according to project requirements.
2. Application development based on CAD design tools and CAE simulation tools.
3. Coordinated development, deployment and testing of solutions in the application computing field.
《Qualification》
1. Proficiency in one of Python, Java, Matlab, C/C++ or other data analysis programming languages.
2. Practical experience in data analysis, optimization algorithms, machine/deep learning.
3. Familiarity with Git version control tools, as well as API, SDK, and Qt development experience.
4. Strong communication and teamwork skills, capable of independent problem-solving.
